title: The Ritual: choose the structure
question: Same visual world (ivory, graphite, Cormorant capitals, owner photography). Three different ways to structure the page for a visitor deciding whether to buy. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: The Day
options.lineage: A day's skincare, morning to night
options.thesis: The page follows a day, and the four steps are shown both morning and evening.
options.viewport: The tray photograph, the h1, the Complete Ritual price and a working Add to bag, all in the first screen.
options.risk: Showing each step twice (morning and evening) can feel repetitive unless the evening rows show only what differs.

regions.label: Complete Ritual offer + Add to bag

options.label: The Ritual Guide
options.lineage: The printed ritual guide that comes in the box
options.thesis: The page is the written guide from the box: one numbered protocol sheet that reads in two minutes.
options.viewport: The tray photograph with the h1, price and Add to bag; below it, the guide's numbered sheet starts.
options.risk: The quietest of the three: model photography shrinks to one plate, so desire comes mostly from the pack cut-outs.

regions.label: 01 Cleanse: product · amount · when · gesture · who it suits
back page: what's in the box + offer

options.label: The Sequence
options.lineage: One continuous application, step by step
options.thesis: One fixed photograph frame that changes as you scroll, from step to step, ending on all four packs together.
options.viewport: The tray photograph, the h1, price and Add to bag, with a 01–04 rail that is also the lightest-to-richest scale.
options.risk: The most build and QA effort: the sticky frame must never hide content, must work on Safari and must fall back to stacked photos on phones.

regions.label: Complete Ritual offer + Add to bag
